answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake in a cryptographic vault like an immutable pearl, where validator admission demands an exponential burning fee C(n) = k * 2^n. Every redundant clone forces an unrecoverable burn, destroying capital like an ember turned to ash. Identity verification renders each malicious node an identifiable pigment in the ledger, imposing insurmountable superlinear economic friction on coordinated attackers.
